subject: Compact Exec Dayflow: finalizing speaker slots, pre-read gating and AV asks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compact Exec Dayflow — initial slotting and pre-read gating

Team,

We have a 1-day on-site with Northridge (executive steering + platform owners) on 2026-09-14. Emily confirmed a condensed day (8:30–17:00) and wants a tight run. Key asks from their side: no more than five executive touchpoints, clear decision moments, and a single consolidated pre-read packet two weeks out.

Please do the following by EOD Monday:
- Marissa: draft a balanced run-of-show that limits exec slots to 20 minutes each and includes one 45-min workshop block for ops/engineering together.
- Laura: own the pre-read outline and list required assets from product and security. Draft needs to be export-ready (PDF) for distribution.
- Aditya: confirm travel windows and onsite arrival plan for our presenters; note any potential travel conflicts.
- Karthik: list AV and room layout constraints (mic counts, confidence monitors, breakout headset needs).

I've attached the initial meeting brief from Emily and the previous deck for context. I'll sync with Emily after we have the first drafts. Keep items actionable with owners.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact Exec Dayflow — initial slotting and pre-read gating

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 9:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> We have a 1-day on-site with Northridge...

Attached: NRP_Run_of_Show_v1.pdf and Presenter_Slot_Matrix.xlsx. High-level notes:
- Morning: 8:30 arrival, 9:00–9:30 coffee + intro (CEO welcome + Redwood topline).
- 9:30–10:00 Exec slot 1: Product vision + ROI (owner: Rishi).
- 10:15–11:00 Ops/engineering workshop (owner: Karthik + Northridge ops lead).
- 11:15–11:35 Exec slot 2: Security/compliance (owner: Laura).
- 12:00–13:00 Lunch + sponsor table (informal).
- Afternoon: two short exec break-ins (20 mins each) and final 45-min synthesis.

Two gating items for pre-reads:
1) Security artifacts (SOC 2 summary + retention policy) — Laura to confirm what can be shared.
2) 1-page case study with expected cost/latency impact — Rishi / Product to produce.

Open call: we have one soft conflict: our lead PM (Samir) is on travel 9/13–9/15. Aditya, can you confirm if Samir can present remotely or we slot alternative owner?

Marissa
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact Exec Dayflow — initial slotting and pre-read gating

Thanks Marissa — attached is a draft of the SLT_pre-read_pack_v3.pdf (redlines inline).

Notes:
- Security: I can include a SOC 2 one-pager and a sanitized retention table. For anything labeled "sensitive", we'll gate it and circulate via secure link (we should confirm Northridge's NDAs; Emily, can you confirm your data team OKs a secure link?).
- Suggested order: 1) Meeting objectives; 2) One-page exec summary; 3) Technical appendix (sized for 2–3 people to skim); 4) Appendix: compliance docs (link gated).
- Page limits: keep the main packet to <10 pages, appendices linked.

Action: I'll finalize the packet by COB Tuesday after Rishi's case study slide. Also flagged an outstanding ask for contracts: our standard guest WiFi form needs venue sign-off — Karthik, please follow up with venueops.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compact Exec Dayflow — initial slotting and pre-read gating

Quick travel update:
- Samir (Lead PM) is on travel 9/13–9/15 and cannot be in-person. He can present remotely for the 9:30 slot if we allow a single A/V confidence monitor and stable wired connection. He prefers remote rather than swapping presenters.
- Our VP Sales (Anika Patel) is available but would prefer a later afternoon slot (14:00–14:30).
- Travel ETA for presenters: most arriving 9/13 evening; Rishi and Karthik arriving 9/14 morning for quick sync.

I'll coordinate flights and Slack channel for onsite day-of comms.

Aditya
Senior Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Barnes <emily@nrpharma.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T11:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Compact Exec Dayflow — initial slotting and pre-read gating

Thanks for the v1 run-of-show — this looks good and tight, which we appreciate. A few quick notes from the Northridge side: 
- Confirmed: remote for Samir is fine as long as there is a confidence monitor and dedicated lane.
- AV ask: we will need two handheld mics for execs and lavalier for the facilitator; can you include a short AV checklist to share with VenueOps?
- Pre-read: our execs want the packet by 2026-08-31 (two weeks before). Can you guarantee a PDF deliverable by then?

I'll loop in VenueOps (cc'd) to confirm room layout and any insurance forms. We also prefer the executive case study to include a small slide showing estimated SLO improvements (latency/cost) — happy to share an internal example if helpful.

Best,
Emily Barnes
Head of Platform Strategy, Northridge Pharmaceuticals

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Barnes <emily@nrpharma.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, VenueOps <venueops@grandhotel.com>, contracts@docusign.com
Date: 2026-08-25T16:07:00-07:00
Subject: Compact Exec Dayflow — final run-of-show & next steps

Emily / Team,

Thanks for the quick confirmation. Final decisions and owners:
- Deliverables timeline: SLT_pre-read_pack_v3.pdf final by 2026-08-31 (owner: Laura; include SOC2 one-pager + gated appendix links).
- Case study / SLO slide: Rishi to deliver 1 slide and 1-pager by 2026-08-27.
- AV checklist (Karthik): submit final specs to VenueOps by 2026-08-28. Key items: 2 handheld mics, 2 confidence monitors (front/rear), one dedicated wired uplink for remote presenter, breakout headsets (8), tech table + technician onsite 8:00–18:00.
- Presenter matrix: Marissa to finalize slot owners and run a single 30-min internal dry run on 2026-09-11 10:00–10:30 (required for all presenters).
- Contracts: contracts@docusign.com — can you please send venue WiFi guest form and any standard addenda to Emily & Rishi for signature by 2026-08-30?

I'll attach the updated run-of-show after Laura's final packet. Thanks everyone — let's stick to the gates.

Rishi
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
